name: Pup joint (integral union pipe)
function: A straight length of high-pressure pipe with a male union sub on one end and a female sub with a wing nut on the other, the basic building block of a temporary treating line.

tabs.overview: Sizes 2 in., 3 in., and 4 in. nominal in lengths from a few inches to 10 ft or more. The union halves are integral to the pipe, not welded on in the field. Each joint carries a serial number and a wall-thickness inspection history.
tabs.engineering: Working pressure 10,000 or 15,000 psi cold; union halves and pipe are matched by pressure class; wall loss limits from the iron inspection program retire a joint.
tabs.safety: A joint with an unreadable serial or no current inspection does not go on a high-pressure line. Restraints on every joint.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Restraints and whip checks on iron; exclusion zone around pressurized lines.
Tree saver in the wellhead; valves fully open or fully closed only; iron inspection.
